pairs: Domum autem suam ædificavit Salomon tredecim annis,
Now Solomon built his own house for thirteen years,
et ad perfectum usque perduxit.
and he brought it to perfection.
Ædificavit quoque domum saltus Libani centum cubitorum longitudinis,
And he built the house from the forest of Lebanon: one hundred cubits in length,
et quinquaginta cubitorum latitudinis,
and fifty cubits in width,
et triginta cubitorum altitudinis:
and thirty cubits in height,
et quatuor deambulacra inter columnas cedrinas:
with four walkways between columns of cedar.
ligna quippe cedrina exciderat in columnas.
For he had hewn the cedar trees into columns.
Et tabulatis cedrinis vestivit totam cameram,
And he clothed the entire vaulted room with panels of cedar.
quæ quadraginta quinque columnis sustentabatur.
And it was supported by forty-five columns.
Unus autem ordo habebat columnas quindecim
Now one row held fifteen columns,
contra se invicem positas,
each positioned opposite another,
et e regione se respicientes,
and looking toward one another,
æquali spatio inter columnas,
with equal spacing between the columns.
et super columnas quadrangulata ligna in cunctis æqualia.
And above the columns there were square beams equal in all things.
Et porticum columnarum fecit quinquaginta cubitorum longitudinis,
And he made a portico of columns,
et triginta cubitorum latitudinis:
fifty cubits in length and thirty cubits in width,
et alteram porticum in facie majoris porticus:
and another portico,
et columnas,
facing the greater portico,
et epistylia super columnas.
with columns and with crossbeams upon the columns.
Porticum quoque solii,
He also made the portico of the throne,
in qua tribunal est,
in which is the tribunal.
fecit:
And he overlaid it with cedar wood,
et texit lignis cedrinis a pavimento usque ad summitatem.
from the floor even to the summit.
Et domuncula,
And in the midst of the portico,
in qua sedebatur ad judicandum,
there was a small house,
erat in media porticu simili opere.
where he would sit in judgment,
Domum quoque fecit filiæ Pharaonis (quam uxorem duxerat Salomon) tali opere,
similar in workmanship.
quali et hanc porticum.
He also made a house for the daughter of Pharaoh (whom Solomon had taken as wife) of the same work and type as this portico.
Omnia lapidibus pretiosis,
All was of precious stones,
qui ad normam quamdam
which had been sawed by a particular standard and measure,
atque mensuram tam intrinsecus quam extrinsecus serrati erant:
as much within as without,
a fundamento usque ad summitatem parietum,
from the foundation even to the summit of the walls,
et extrinsecus usque ad atrium majus.
and outside even to the great atrium.
Fundamenta autem de lapidibus pretiosis,
Now the foundations were of precious stones:
lapidibus magnis,
great stones of eight
decem sive octo cubitorum.
or ten cubits.
Et desuper lapides pretiosi æqualis mensuræ secti erant, similiterque de cedro.
And above these, there were precious stones, of equal measure, which had been cut in a manner similar to boards of cedar.
Et atrium majus rotundum trium ordinum de lapidibus sectis,
And the great atrium was round,
et unius ordinis de dolata cedro:
with three rows of cut stones and one row of cut cedar,
necnon et in atrio domus Domini interiori,
even as it also was in the interior atrium of the house of the Lord,
et in porticu domus.
and in the portico of the house.
Misit quoque rex Salomon,
And king Solomon sent
et tulit Hiram de Tyro,
and brought Hiram of Tyre,
filium mulieris viduæ de tribu Nephthali,
the son of a widowed woman,
patre Tyrio,
from the tribe of Naphtali,
artificem ærarium,
whose father was a Tyrian,
et plenum sapientia,
an artisan in brass,
et intelligentia,
and full of wisdom,
et doctrina,
and understanding,
ad faciendum omne opus ex ære.
and knowledge in order to form every work of brass.
Qui cum venisset ad regem Salomonem,
And when he had gone to king Solomon,
fecit omne opus ejus.
he wrought all his work.
Et finxit duas columnas æreas,
And he cast two columns of brass.
decem et octo cubitorum altitudinis columnam unam:
Each column was eighteen cubits in height,
et linea duodecim cubitorum ambiebat columnam utramque.
and a line of twelve cubits encompassed both columns.
Duo quoque capitella fecit,
Also,
quæ ponerentur super capita columnarum,
he made two heads of molten brass,
fusilia ex ære:
which would be set upon the tops of the columns:
quinque cubitorum altitudinis capitellum unum,
one head was five cubits in height,
et quinque cubitorum altitudinis capitellum alterum:
and the other head was five cubits in height.
et quasi in modum retis,
And there was something like a network of chains,
et catenarum sibi invicem miro opere contextarum.
woven together in a wonderful manner.
Utrumque capitellum columnarum fusile erat:
Both heads of the columns were cast,
septena versuum retiacula in capitello uno,
and seven rows of little nets traversed one head,
et septena retiacula in capitello altero.
and seven little nets were on the other head.
Et perfecit columnas,
And he finished the columns with two rows all around each network,
et duos ordines per circuitum retiaculorum singulorum,
so that these covered the heads,
ut tegerent capitella quæ erant super summitatem,
which were at the top,
malogranatorum:
with pomegranates.
eodem modo fecit et capitello secundo.
And he did in like manner to the second head.
Capitella autem quæ erant super capita columnarum,
Now the heads that were at the top of the columns,
quasi opere lilii fabricata erant in porticu quatuor cubitorum.
in the portico of four cubits, had been fabricated with a work of lilies.
Et rursum alia capitella in summitate columnarum desuper juxta mensuram columnæ contra retiacula:
And again, there were other heads at the tops of the columns above, in accord with the measure of the column opposite the netting.
malogranatorum autem ducenti ordines erant in circuitu capitelli secundi.
And there were two hundred of the pomegranates, in rows around the second head.
Et statuit duas columnas in porticu templi:
And he stationed the two columns in the portico of the temple.
cumque statuisset columnam dexteram,
And when he had stationed the column on the right,
vocavit eam nomine Jachin:
he called its name Jachin.
similiter erexit columnam secundam,
Similarly, he erected the second column,
et vocavit nomen ejus Booz.
and he called its name Boaz.
Et super capita columnarum opus in modum lilii posuit:
And above the tops of the columns, he set a work in the manner of lilies.
perfectumque est opus columnarum.
And the work of the columns was perfected.
Fecit quoque mare fusile decem cubitorum a labio usque ad labium,
He also made a molten sea, of ten cubits from brim to brim,
rotundum in circuitu:
rounded on all sides.
quinque cubitorum altitudo ejus,
Its height was five cubits,
et resticula triginta cubitorum cingebat illud per circuitum.
and a thin rope of thirty cubits wrapped it all around.
Et sculptura subter labium circuibat illud decem cubitis ambiens mare:
And a sculpted work under the brim encircled it for ten cubits going around the sea.
duo ordines sculpturarum striatarum erant fusiles.
There were two rows cast of striated sculptures.
Et stabat super duodecim boves,
And it was standing upon twelve oxen,
e quibus tres respiciebant ad aquilonem,
of which three were looking toward the north,
et tres ad occidentem,
and three toward the west,
et tres ad meridiem,
and three toward the south,
et tres ad orientem:
and three toward the east.
et mare super eos desuper erat:
And the sea above was over them.
quorum posteriora universa intrinsecus latitabant.
And their posteriors were entirely hidden within.
Grossitudo autem luteris, trium unciarum erat:
And the basin was the thickness of three twelfths.
labiumque ejus quasi labium calicis,
And its brim was like the brim of a chalice,
et folium repandi lilii:
or like the outturned petal of a lily.
duo millia batos capiebat.
It contained two thousand baths.
Et fecit decem bases æneas,
And he made ten bases of brass:
quatuor cubitorum longitudinis bases singulas,
each base was four cubits in length,
et quatuor cubitorum latitudinis,
and four cubits in width,
et trium cubitorum altitudinis.
and three cubits in height.
Et ipsum opus basium, interrasile erat:
And the work itself of the bases was engraved;
et sculpturæ inter juncturas.
and there were sculptures between the junctures.
Et inter coronulas et plectas,
And between the little crowns and the edges,
leones et boves et cherubim,
there were lions, and oxen, and cherubim;
et in juncturis similiter desuper:
and similarly in the junctures above.
et subter leones et boves, quasi lora ex ære dependentia.
And under the lions and oxen were something like bands of brass hanging down.
Et quatuor rotæ per bases singulas, et axes ærei:
And each base had four wheels, with axels of brass.
et per quatuor partes quasi humeruli subter luterem fusiles,
And at the four sides were something like little arms, under the cast basin,
contra se invicem respectantes.
facing away from one another.
Os quoque luteris intrinsecus erat in capitis summitate:
Also,
et quod forinsecus apparebat,
the mouth of the interior of the basin was at the top of the head.
unius cubiti erat totum rotundum,
And what was visible outside was of one cubit all around,
pariterque habebat unum cubitum et dimidium:
and altogether it had one cubit and a half.
in angulis autem columnarum variæ cælaturæ erant:
Now at the corners of the columns were diverse engravings.
et media intercolumnia,
And the spaces between the columns were square,
quadrata non rotunda.
not round.
Quatuor quoque rotæ quæ per quatuor angulos basis erant,
And the four wheels,
cohærebant sibi subter basim:
which were at the four corners of the base,
una rota habebat altitudinis cubitum
were joined to one another under the base.
et semis.
The height of one wheel held one cubit and a half.
Tales autem rotæ erant quales solent in curru fieri:
Now these were the kind of wheels such as are often made for a chariot.
et axes earum,
And their axels,
et radii,
and spokes,
et canthi,
and tires,
et modioli, omnia fusilia.
and centers were all cast.
Nam et humeruli illi quatuor per singulos angulos basis unius,
And the four little arms, which were at each corner of a base,
ex ipsa basi fusiles et conjuncti erant.
were cast and joined together as part of the base itself.
In summitate autem basis erat quædam rotunditas dimidii cubiti,
And at the summit of the base, there was a round stand of one half cubit,
ita fabrefacta ut luter desuper posset imponi,
fabricated so that the basin could be placed upon it,
habens cælaturas suas,
having its engravings,
variasque sculpturas ex semetipsa.
and various sculptures of its own.
Sculpsit quoque in tabulatis illis quæ erant ex ære,
He also engraved those plates, which were of brass.
et in angulis, cherubim,
And at the corners were cherubim,
et leones, et palmas,
and lions, and palm trees,
quasi in similitudinem hominis stantis,
standing out, as if in the likeness of a man,
ut non cælata, sed apposita per circuitum viderentur.
so that they seemed not to be engraved, but placed adjacent on all sides.
In hunc modum fecit decem bases,
In this manner,
fusura una,
he made ten bases with the same casting
et mensura,
and measure,
sculpturaque consimili.
and very similar engravings.
Fecit quoque decem luteres æneos:
He also made ten hand basins of brass.
quadraginta batos capiebat luter unus,
One hand basin contained four baths,
eratque quatuor cubitorum:
and was of four cubits.
singulos quoque luteres per singulas, id est,
And each basin he set upon a base,
decem bases, posuit.
which is ten bases.
Et constituit decem bases,
And he stationed the ten bases,
quinque ad dexteram partem templi,
five to the right side of the temple,
et quinque ad sinistram:
and five to the left.
mare autem posuit ad dexteram partem templi contra orientem ad meridiem.
And the sea he placed to the right side of the temple, opposite the east, toward the south.
Fecit ergo Hiram lebetes,
Then Hiram made cooking pots,
et scutras,
and trays,
et hamulas,
and small hooks.
et perfecit omne opus regis Salomonis in templo Domini.
And he completed all the work of king Solomon in the temple of the Lord:
Columnas duas,
the two columns,
et funiculos capitellorum super capitella columnarum duos:
and the two cords of the heads over the tops of the columns,
et retiacula duo, ut operirent duos funiculos qui erant super capita columnarum.
and the two networks which covered the two cords that were above the tops of the columns;
Et malogranata quadringenta in duobus retiaculis:
and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks,
duos versus malogranatorum in retiaculis singulis,
two turnings of pomegranates for each network,
ad operiendos funiculos capitellorum qui erant super capita columnarum.
in order to cover the cords of the heads, which were above the tops of the columns;
Et bases decem,
and the ten bases,
et luteres decem super bases.
and the ten basins on the bases;
Et mare unum,
and the one sea,
et boves duodecim subter mare.
and the twelve oxen under the sea;
Et lebetes,
and the cooking pots,
et scutras,
and the trays,
et hamulas,
and the small hooks.
omnia vasa quæ fecit Hiram regi Salomoni in domo Domini,
All of the items that Hiram made for king Solomon, for the house of the Lord,
de auricalco erant.
were of golden brass.
In campestri regione Jordanis fudit ea rex in argillosa terra,
In the open regions near the Jordan,
inter Sochoth
the king cast these,
et Sarthan.
in the clay soil between Succoth and Zarethan.
Et posuit Salomon omnia vasa:
And Solomon positioned all the items.
propter multitudinem autem nimiam non erat pondus æris.
But because of its exceedingly great amount, the brass was not weighed.
Fecitque Salomon omnia vasa in domo Domini:
And Solomon made all the furniture for the house of the Lord:
altare aureum,
the altar of gold,
et mensam super quam ponerentur panes propositionis,
and the table of gold,
auream:
upon which the bread of the presence would be placed;
et candelabra aurea,
and the gold lampstands,
quinque ad dexteram,
five to the right,
et quinque ad sinistram contra oraculum,
and five to the left, opposite the oracle,
ex auro puro:
of pure gold;
et quasi lilii flores, et lucernas desuper aureas:
and likenesses of lily blossoms, with lamps above them,
et forcipes aureos,
of gold; and gold tongs;
et hydrias,
and water pots,
et fuscinulas,
and little forks,
et phialas,
and bowls,
et mortariola,
and little mortars,
et thuribula,
and censers,
de auro purissimo:
of the purest gold;
et cardines ostiorum domus interioris Sancti sanctorum,
and the hinges of the doors,
et ostiorum domus templi,
for the interior house of the Holy of Holies and for the doors of the house of the temple,
ex auro erant.
which were of gold.
Et perfecit omne opus quod faciebat Salomon in domo Domini,
And Solomon perfected all the work that he was doing in the house of the Lord.
et intulit quæ sanctificaverat David pater suus,
And he brought in the things that his father David had sanctified:
argentum,
the silver,
et aurum,
and the gold,
et vasa,
and the vessels.
reposuitque in thesauris domus Domini.
And he stored these in the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
